text:
emma: quick follow-up to yesterday's postmortem — capturing owners for remediation + timeline. high-level asks: (A) immediate mitigations to protect tail latency, (B) long-term fixes, (C) dashboards and runbook updates, (D) SLO adjustment only as last resort.
ryan: I'll take the route-throttling spike (INF-6001). will prototype a staging rule and smoke test today. ETA: 2026-03-28.
dee: I'll own cache-fanout fix (INF-6002) — implement staggered regen and backoff. plan: small canary by Mon, full rollout next week.
metrics-bot: INF-6001 created — owner: ryan — due: 2026-03-28.
ops-bot: INF-6002 created — owner: dee — due: 2026-03-29.
emma: dashboard requests: p95/p99 by model & seq-length bins, route-level QPS vs p99 heatmap, and an "incident recurrence" annotation layer. can someone add these? 
ryan: i'll add the QPS/p99 heatmap to the ops board. snippet i'll test: ```
overrides:
  long_seq_pool:
    weight: 0.2
  default:
    weight: 0.8
```
dee: adding seq-length bins [0-128,129-512,513-2048,>2048] and recurrence annotations. draft dashboards by EOD.
emma: on SLOs — i prefer policy-based mitigations over SLO relaxation. if we need temporary SLO delta, propose automatic unwind after 10 days and notify customers. 24h objection window.
ryan: agree. also propose a short-term error-budget cap: if >2% burn in 24h, escalate to page.
metrics-bot: annotation added to postmortem: "3-week recurring pattern noted".
emma: assigning INF-6003 -> ryan (routing tests), INF-6004 -> dee (dashboard panels). set tentative deadlines.
ops-bot: INF-6003 created — owner: ryan — due: 2026-03-26.
ops-bot: INF-6004 created — owner: dee — due: 2026-03-25.
emma: thanks. sync tomorrow 09:30 to validate canaries. if owners can't meet deadlines, flag in thread.
ryan: ACK.
dee: ACK.
